question.text:
Which of the following relations between the set $\mathbb{N}$ (natural numbers) and the set $\{\mathbb{N}, \mathbb{R}\}$ are true?

Select all that apply.

  1. $\mathbb{N} \in\{\mathbb{N}, \mathbb{R}\}$
  2. $\mathbb{N} \subseteq\{\mathbb{N}, \mathbb{R}\}$
  3. $\mathbb{N} \notin\{\mathbb{N}, \mathbb{R}\}$
  4. $\mathbb{N} \nsubseteq\{\mathbb{N}, \mathbb{R}\}$
